_how: ElevenLabs MCP, one take each. Sound: an sfx node, model eleven_text_to_sound_v3, prompt = style.sfx + ' ' + prompt, duration_seconds = seconds, prompt_influence 0.5; save as sfx/<id>.mp3. Music: a music node, model eleven_music_v2_5, prompt = style.music + ' ' + style + ' Instrumental, no vocals, <bpm> BPM.' (looping tracks add 'Steady energy start to end so it loops cleanly.', then 'No <exclude>.'), duration_seconds = length_s, instrumental; save as music/<id>.mp3. A looping track may record loop_start and loop_end (seconds) once trimmed. Create the node with estimate_only, set its parameters, then run it, so nothing is charged twice. Check coverage and progress with: node game/audio/status.js

style.sfx: Retro-futuristic pixel-game sound, clean and short, no voice:
style.music: Cyberpunk night shift in a rain-soaked megacity security operations centre, retro pixel-game soundtrack mixing chiptune square waves with analog synthwave pads.

dice_roll.prompt: a handful of six-sided dice rattling in a cupped hand and tumbling onto a felt table

dice_land.prompt: a single die clacking to a stop on a hard table

die_match.event: a crew die takes a threat die showing its number
die_match.prompt: a crisp digital lock-on blip followed by a small glass shard breaking

die_double.event: a die rolls a double (now the synth 'double')
die_double.prompt: two bright rising chime notes, a lucky sparkle

die_reroll.event: a player pays 1 HP to reroll a die
die_reroll.prompt: a short electric zap, then one die rattling and rolling again

die_miss.prompt: a dull low digital buzz, an error blip

row_roll.event: the two amber row dice roll
row_roll.prompt: two heavy dice rolling on metal with a low ominous electric hum underneath

card_flip.event: the next card of the feed is flipped
card_flip.prompt: a playing card flipped over quickly on a table with a soft digital swish

situation.prompt: a soft office pager chirp, two short beeps

damage.event: an analyst takes damage (now the synth 'hit')
damage.prompt: a punchy low digital impact with a short static crackle

knockout.event: an analyst drops to 0 HP (now the synth 'down')
knockout.prompt: a computer monitor powering off with a falling tone and a heavy thud

heal.prompt: a gentle rising shimmer of soft synth bells, restoring energy

guard.prompt: a translucent energy shield snapping up with a bright hum

fight_won.event: the last alarm in play is knocked down
fight_won.prompt: a short triumphant three-note synth arpeggio with a digital sparkle

baseline.prompt: a firewall rule locking into place: a deep mechanical clunk, then a rising confirmation chime

tuck.event: a baselined alarm slides under an agent
tuck.prompt: a card sliding under another card, then a soft electric power-up

row_add.event: a beaten alarm goes onto the persistence row
row_add.prompt: a card placed down with a faint ominous low hum lingering

comeback.event: an alarm comes back off the row (now the synth 'comeback')
comeback.prompt: a creepy glitching rise, a corrupted signal reconnecting

item_draw.prompt: a small loot pickup chime with a card swish

boss_reveal.event: the boss arrives at 05:59 (now the synth 'boss')
boss_reveal.prompt: a massive alarm siren starting low, a deep sub bass drop and distorted static

shift_won.event: the shift is won (now the synth 'win')
shift_won.prompt: a hopeful sunrise synth chord swell with bright chiptune bells

shift_lost.event: the shift is lost (now the synth 'loss')
shift_lost.prompt: a descending three-note synth with a dying power hum and a final click

kw_regen.event: a Regen alarm puts a die back
kw_regen.prompt: a wet organic squelch fused with a digital rebuild blip

kw_escalate.prompt: a rising warning tone that speeds up, pressure building

ability_HUN.event: the Hunter's extra die in a fight's first round
ability_HUN.prompt: a radar sweep ping that locks onto a target

ability_RES.prompt: a medic headset beep and a warm healing pulse

ability_ENG.prompt: a ratchet wrench click and rapid keyboard typing

ability_SOA.prompt: an arcane magic swirl blended with a cascade of automation beeps

agent_triage.prompt: a quick sorting whirr and two extra dice clicking in

agent_enrich.event: the Enrichment Agent turns a die
agent_enrich.prompt: a data scan beep with a die flipping over

agent_contain.event: the Containment Agent cuts an alarm's damage
agent_contain.prompt: a heavy blast door sliding shut with a pneumatic hiss

agent_recover.event: the Recovery Agent heals after a won fight
agent_recover.prompt: a system restore chime, a soft upward sweep

agent_watchlist.event: the Watchlist Agent keeps an alarm on the row
agent_watchlist.prompt: a security camera servo turning and a confirming beep

item_surge.prompt: an energy surge crackle and three dice clattering

item_intel.prompt: a fast data download stream with a bright completion ping

item_isolate.prompt: a network cable being yanked out, a disconnect zap

item_coffee.prompt: hot coffee poured into a paper cup and a satisfied sip

item_freeze.prompt: an icy crystallizing crackle and a padlock click

item_takedown.prompt: a rubber stamp slammed down hard and a server shutting off

mailer_arrive.prompt: an old email notification chime that distorts into a glitchy bounce

mailer_strike.prompt: an envelope slap with a harsh error beep

macro_arrive.prompt: a mischievous small creature cackle made of keyboard clicks

macro_strike.prompt: a quick claw scratch and a document crumpling

spray_arrive.prompt: an aerosol spray hiss mixed with rapid failed-login beeps

banshee_arrive.prompt: a phone vibrating on a desk that rises into an eerie electronic wail

vibe_arrive.prompt: a cheerful app launch jingle that glitches and breaks apart

wraith_arrive.prompt: a ghostly whoosh with faint terminal typing that vanishes

druid_arrive.prompt: rustling scrap metal and a scavenger sniffing around

bat_arrive.prompt: a small drone buzzing in with rapid sonar chirps

bat_strike.prompt: a high-pitched sonar burst and a dive

imp_arrive.prompt: a friendly pop-up notification ding followed by a sly snicker

imp_strike.prompt: a quick pickpocket swipe and a coin jingle

mimic_arrive.prompt: a normal computer hum that suddenly turns into a deep monstrous growl

mimic_strike.prompt: a heavy chomping bite with metal teeth

ogre_arrive.prompt: heavy stomping footsteps and a crackling fire

ogre_strike.prompt: a massive club smash with a flame burst

leech_arrive.prompt: a slimy wet suction mixed with a data drain hum

hydra_arrive.prompt: many small robotic voices of a swarm multiplying, hissing and clicking

specter_arrive.prompt: a ghostly golden shimmer with a ticket punch click echoing

specter_strike.prompt: an ethereal cold whoosh passing through

wyrmling_arrive.prompt: a fast data upload whoosh with a small dragon chirp

title.style: Title theme: a slow brooding synth bass, distant rain ambience, a lonely square-wave melody over warm pads, building to a confident hook.

deal.scene: setup: picking analysts and dealing items
deal.style: Briefing music: a steady muted arpeggio, soft kick, a calm focused mood like getting ready at a desk.

feed.scene: between cards, the quiet of the shift
feed.style: Ambient night-shift loop: a low hum of servers, sparse soft square-wave notes, gentle pads, quiet tension.

situation.scene: a situation card asks a choice
situation.style: Thinking music: a ticking hi-hat, a curious plucked synth motif, light and a little playful.

story.style: Story music: a melancholy electric piano with chiptune echoes, cinematic and reflective.

fight.style: Battle theme: a driving square-wave lead, a pumping saw bass, punchy chiptune drums, urgent but fun.

fight_multi.style: Intense battle theme: two clashing leads, a fast arpeggiated bass, heavier drums and alarm-like stabs.

boss_wyrm.style: Boss theme for a ransomware dragon syndicate: a heavy distorted synth bass riff, clanging metal percussion, a menacing minor-key lead.

boss_apt.style: Boss theme for a patient spy: a stealthy pulsing bass, tense ticking percussion, a cold minor-key lead that slowly closes in.

boss_ai.style: Boss theme for a rogue artificial intelligence: glitchy stuttering arpeggios, a massive robotic bass, fast drums and a cold synthetic choir pad.

shift_won.style: Victory fanfare at sunrise: bright square-wave brass, rising arpeggios, ending on a held major chord.

shift_lost.style: Game over: a slow falling synth melody over a fading server hum, ending on a single low note.
